Gate.description:
Approval class id. `free`, `apply` and `review` are dek's; an app's are
`<namespace>.<local>`. The core enforces the class. dek runs the flow
the class was registered with before anything reaches the core, and
treats an id that nothing registered as `review`. dek never asks the
core to waive a class, and cannot check that the core enforces an app's
class as its builder meant: that is the core's job.

A core sends an app's class ids only to a dek that registered them; any
other dek shows them as unknown, handled as `review`.

Target.description: Platform a feature or pane works on.

description: One manifest entry: a noun-verb action a core offers.

granted.description:
The viewer may invoke it at the scope the manifest was fetched for.
Absent reads as true. A catalog action bound to an ungranted
capability renders disabled with the reason, not an error on click.

read.description:
A side-effect-free read: only these may back a catalog query.
Absent reads as false, so an unmarked capability is never queried.
